candidates.spoken: Its tail broke off, and three people were killed.
The crew believed the autothrottle was holding speed.
It had been left in a mode that didn't.
The airspeed kept falling, and nobody noticed in time.
The approach had been too slow and too low.
The go-around came seconds too late.
Training on automation modes was strengthened afterward.

script.spoken: Its tail broke off, and three people were killed. A Boeing 777 slammed into the seawall at San Francisco airport. The approach had been too slow and too low. The crew believed the autothrottle was holding speed. It had been left in a mode that didn't. The airspeed kept falling, and nobody noticed in time. The go-around came seconds too late. Training on automation modes was strengthened afterward.
